## Description

A clear and concise description of what feature you'd like to see added.

## Motivation

Why would this feature be useful? What problem does it solve?

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you envision this feature working. Include any implementation details if you have ideas.

## Alternatives Considered

Have you thought of alternative approaches?

## Additional Context

Any other context or examples that help explain the feature request.

# Show how the feature would be used
